title: Geometry coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-adjunction-restrictions], [def-pur-transport-source-comparisons]. A smooth geometric index over the fixed algebraic closure of the finite field consists of separated finite-type schemes $X,Y$, a morphism over that field, its pure smooth dimension $d\ge0$, and a compactification. The coefficient prime distinct from the base characteristic is a unit in the field. An explicit adjunction at such an index consists of proofs that actual compact support and $J_{f,c,d}$ preserve $P_c$, and an adjunction between these literal restricted functors. Its trace is the underlying ambient counit, not an additional map.
